# FFmpeg video processing

见藏 uses the FFmpeg and FFprobe command-line programs for local video processing. This package contains the 64-bit Windows LGPL shared build from FFmpeg Builds `autobuild-2026-11-18-12-39` at FFmpeg revision `e22a4510c9`. The FFmpeg copyright belongs to its contributors. [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/) · [Binary release and checksums](https://github.com/FFmpeg-Builds/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/tag/autobuild-2026-11-18-12-39)

The original license is in `notices/LICENSE.txt`. The `source` directory contains the corresponding FFmpeg source and the build recipes. The recipes identify the platform, configuration and sources for the build dependencies. [Upstream revision](https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/e22a4510c9) · [Build recipes](https://github.com/FFmpeg-Builds/FFmpeg-Builds/tree/autobuild-2026-11-18-12-39)
